# Gemini

> Gemini is a regulated cryptocurrency exchange and custody platform offering trading, staking, wallet services, and institutional solutions for buying, selling, and securing digital assets.

Gemini provides both retail and institutional crypto trading solutions with regulatory compliance under New York Banking Law and SOC 2 Type 2 certification. The platform supports 80+ cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana, with advanced trading tools, self-custody options, and rewards programs.

## Key Topics

- Bitcoin
- Ethereum
- Solana
- Regulated Exchange
- Cold Storage Custody
- ActiveTrader
- Margin Trading

- Staking Rewards
- Gemini Dollar (GUSD)

- SOC 2 Type 2
- ISO 27001
- Over-the-Counter (OTC)

## Core Trading Platforms

- [Gemini Exchange](https://www.gemini.com/exchange): Buy & sell Bitcoin, Ethereum and 80+ cryptocurrencies securely on Gemini's regulated exchange
- [ActiveTrader](https://www.gemini.com/activetrader): Advanced crypto trading platform with professional charting, order types, and API integration
- [Gemini Perpetuals](https://www.gemini.com/perpetuals): Leverage trading with derivatives, advanced risk management, and perpetual contracts
- [Margin Trading](https://www.gemini.com/margin-trading): Trade crypto with up to 5x leverage for long and short positions

## Institutional Solutions

- [Gemini Institutional](https://www.gemini.com/institutions): Comprehensive institutional crypto trading, custody, and execution solutions for funds and enterprises
- [Institutional Exchange](https://www.gemini.com/institutions/exchange): Advanced trading platform for institutions with API access and sophisticated order management
- [Institutional Custody](https://www.gemini.com/institutions/custody): Institutional-grade cold storage with ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type 2 certification, and multisignature security
- [Gemini OTC](https://www.gemini.com/institutions/otc): Over-the-counter trading for institutional clients executing large crypto orders
- [Gemini Clearing](https://www.gemini.com/clearing): Off-exchange settlement and trading solutions with KYC/AML compliance for institutional partners

## Custody & Security

- [Gemini Custody](https://www.gemini.com/custody): Secure institutional-grade cold storage with multisignature security and comprehensive insurance coverage
- [Gemini Wallet](https://www.gemini.com/wallet): Self-custody wallet with passkey authentication, multi-chain DeFi access, and onchain ecosystem integration

## Earning & Rewards

- [Gemini Staking](https://www.gemini.com/staking): Earn crypto rewards with up to 6% APR on Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, Polkadot, and other assets
- [Gemini Credit Card](https://www.gemini.com/credit-card): Earn crypto rewards in Bitcoin with the Gemini Credit Card Mastercard, no annual fee

## Digital Assets

- [Gemini Dollar (GUSD)](https://www.gemini.com/dollar): Regulated stablecoin backed 1:1 by US dollars, enabling stable value transfers and trading
